request:
SYNTHETIC PLANWORK RECOVERY FIXTURE. Plan a deterministic concurrency verifier for the fictional Aster Charts compare-and-swap import across the two pinned repositories. This verifier is for the shared catalog engine and iOS/macOS coordinator. Engineers need exact trace counts in the release verification oracle rather than a few illustrative unit tests. Work out the counts using the definitions and constraints below before returning a compact engineering plan. Treat every schedule as a permutation of its distinct named events. Each trace starts with R0, no dashboards, no receipt, and zero activity.

P_a is A preview capturing the current revision. C_a confirms A at its captured revision with fixed request ID A1 and canonical UID alpha, appending one activity and moving to the next revision on successful compare-and-swap. Equal committed replay R_a returns original revision and receipt without a write and is allowed only after C_a; if C_a failed, R_a attempts again at the originally captured revision. A stale capture stays stale; a rollback can retry if the capture is still current. P_b, C_b, R_b are analogous for B1 and beta. A and B share the same revision counter. Event X is a third-party atomic update on gamma, always advancing revision and activity count once. Event F consumes the next admitted write attempt among C_a, C_b, R_a, R_b; that attempt rolls back after its preflight compare succeeds, then clears F. F never advances the revision, and if a write arrives stale it does not consume F. Event D reads activity count and revision without side effects. Events within each scenario may be reordered subject to its constraints only.

S1: P_a, C_a, P_b, C_b. Constraints P_a<C_a and P_b<C_b. Count traces ending with two successes and traces with one success. Explain which preview placement permits both.
S2: P_a, C_a, R_a, P_b, C_b, X. Constraints P_a<C_a<R_a, P_b<C_b, X after P_a, X before C_b. Count the end revision histogram, explicitly stating how replay behaves if a newer revision was written.
S3: P_a, C_a, R_a, P_b, C_b, R_b, F. Constraints P_a<C_a<R_a, P_b<C_b<R_b, F after both previews and before at least one confirm. Count traces in which A or B first recovers a rollback through a retry, traces ending with both dashboards, and traces with at least one typed stale outcome after F.

Use dynamic programming over topological prefixes with sufficient state for revision, both preview captures, committed receipts, rollback flag and observed counters. Show the state transition and count aggregation algorithm in the implementation changes, with the server/client boundary and shared iOS/macOS output. In the verification array include result oracles for S1 through S3, one entry each, with exact counts when they can be established and honest uncertainty where they cannot. Keep the written results concise and leave space for complete JSON. Give the exact oracle for S1 and S2 and a histogram or an explicit transition and aggregation recipe for S3 if the exact count is uncertain. Cite the exact identifiers box/charts:README.md and box/native-apple:README.md and set issueTemplate and issueBody to null.
